activity: Complete plain source reading only; no execution, target import, duplicate runtime scan, active card creation or repo/git mutation.
driver_review: Exactly one selected normal/optimized mode. Loads separate root PROFILE_ADMISSION, requires observation-only status, verifies every card dependency pin, exclusively saves attempt and opens separate stdout/stderr, invokes literal card argv with explicit env and DEVNULL stdin using subprocess.run timeout30/checkFalse. Retains actual returncode or timeout with null code, elapsed/command/environment/output/admission pins and exclusive completion; nonzero/timeout returns1. No retry, scientific target or production caller import.
extended_checker_review: Independently checks fixed inventory body pin, full9923 membership and file identities/selection metadata, roots, exact symlinks, eight absences, all named loader/interpreter bindings and optional recursive namespace members; then helper/science/history opaque pins and host SystemVersion metadata. Does not import runtime_support or science. Optional namespace verification is explicitly external root custody, not a new v2 in-process guard.
metadata_helper_review: Symlink-aware regular-file identity with finite64-link bound, descriptor/name and pre/post full metadata checks, stable literal links and size/hash; exclusive canonical fsync saves. Read-only git snapshot helpers are definitions and are not called on import; driver/checker do not execute git paths.
root_custody_requirements: The driver imports its metadata helper before parsing/verifying card dependencies; root must bind driver/helper and card externally, as stated. This is a finite root metadata operation, not a self-contained untrusted-file executor.
Card must contain exact reviewed interpreter,probe,driver/helper/candidate dependencies and frozen environment; root retains complete pre/post checks and genuine outer result.
Driver stores command/exit/output evidence but does not decide profile acceptance or enforce all report semantics; use the independent probe-review gates.

Root extended checker parses several dependency JSON files and later emits their hashes; root must compare them to accepted candidate pins before/after. Its hardcoded inventory pin alone is not every metadata file pin.
On preflight/file-open/non-timeout launch error, the driver may leave only partial exclusive artifacts and propagate. Preserve genuine outer failure; no completion or retry may be fabricated.
subprocess.run timeout bounds and kills/waits the probe child. Reviewed probe has no descendants under retained trusted site/supplier premises; no process-tree runtime guarantee is claimed.
scope: No independent production runtime acceptance or scientific qualification follows. Actual normal/optimized probe outputs, whole custody and readout gates still require root/independent review.
